config.ddl_with_pk:
CREATE TABLE data_pk (
        id          INT            NOT NULL,
        name        VARCHAR(50)    NOT NULL,
        email       VARCHAR(100)   NOT NULL,
        age         INT            NOT NULL,
        city        VARCHAR(30)    NOT NULL,
        salary      DECIMAL(12,2)  NOT NULL,
        created_at  DATETIME       NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (id)
    ) ENGINE=InnoDB
config.ddl_without_pk:
CREATE TABLE data_nopk (
        id          INT            NOT NULL,
        name        VARCHAR(50)    NOT NULL,
        email       VARCHAR(100)   NOT NULL,
        age         INT            NOT NULL,
        city        VARCHAR(30)    NOT NULL,
        salary      DECIMAL(12,2)  NOT NULL,
        created_at  DATETIME       NOT NULL
        
    ) ENGINE=InnoDB
